facts.text: I slept through the alarm again. Missed the vows, but I made the reception in time for the cake.
facts.why: At the first wedding Charles and Scarlett are late but barely make it in time, and Charles is the best man. It is the third wedding, Carrie's, where Charles arrives after the ceremony has started. 'Missed the vows' does not fit the first wedding the menu is set at.
facts.fix: May we all in our dotage be proud to say, 'I was adored once too.'
